# Presentations

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Resources](../../README.md) • [Training](../README.md)**

---

> This directory contains presentation materials for the Enterprise Architecture Practice, including slides, supporting documentation, and resources for various audiences and contexts.

---
page_texts.3:
[resources/training/presentations/README.md#executive-briefings]

### Executive Briefings

Strategic-level presentations for leadership audiences:

- EA practice overview and value proposition
- Architectural roadmap and transformation updates
- Business impact and ROI demonstrations
- Strategic technology direction briefings
page_texts.4:
[resources/training/presentations/README.md#technical-deep-dives]

### Technical Deep Dives

Detailed technical content for architecture and engineering teams:

- Reference architecture walkthroughs
- Technology selection rationale and comparisons
- Implementation patterns and best practices
- Architecture decision record (ADR) presentations
page_texts.5:
[resources/training/presentations/README.md#training-materials]

### Training Materials

Educational content for skill development and onboarding:

- EA fundamentals and methodology training
- Domain-specific architecture training modules
- Tool and framework training materials
- Certification preparation content
page_texts.6:
[resources/training/presentations/README.md#conference-presentations]

### Conference Presentations

External-facing presentations for industry events:

- Case studies and success stories
- Industry best practices and lessons learned
- Thought leadership and innovation showcases
- Community engagement materials
page_texts.8:
[resources/training/presentations/README.md#content-guidelines]

### Content Guidelines

- Follow Gainwell branding and style guidelines
- Include appropriate confidentiality markings
- Use consistent terminology from our [glossary](../../../foundation/glossary.md)
- Reference supporting documentation where applicable
page_texts.9:
[resources/training/presentations/README.md#technical-requirements]

### Technical Requirements

- Use standard presentation formats (PowerPoint, PDF)
- Include speaker notes and presenter guides
- Provide both full and abbreviated versions where applicable
- Ensure accessibility compliance (508/WCAG standards)
page_texts.10:
[resources/training/presentations/README.md#version-control]

### Version Control

- Maintain presentation version history
- Include creation and last-modified dates
- Document author and reviewer information
- Archive outdated presentations appropriately
page_texts.12:
[resources/training/presentations/README.md#internal-presentations]

### Internal Presentations

- All internal presentations should align with EA principles and standards
- Reference current architectural decisions and approved patterns
- Include contact information for follow-up questions
- Provide links to detailed documentation in this repository
page_texts.13:
[resources/training/presentations/README.md#external-presentations]

### External Presentations

- Ensure appropriate legal and compliance review
- Remove or redact sensitive internal information
- Follow Gainwell external communication policies
- Include proper attribution and disclaimers
page_texts.15:
[resources/training/presentations/README.md#submission-process]

### Submission Process

1. Create presentation content following our standards
2. Include supporting documentation and speaker notes
3. Submit for review through normal pull request process
4. Ensure appropriate categorization and metadata
page_texts.16:
[resources/training/presentations/README.md#review-criteria]

### Review Criteria

- Content accuracy and alignment with EA practice
- Technical correctness and currency
- Brand compliance and professional quality
- Appropriate audience targeting and messaging
page_texts.18:
[resources/training/presentations/README.md#regular-updates]

### Regular Updates

- Review and update presentations quarterly
- Archive outdated content appropriately
- Maintain currency with latest architectural decisions
- Update references to reflect current documentation
page_texts.19:
[resources/training/presentations/README.md#quality-assurance]

### Quality Assurance

- Periodic review for brand compliance
- Technical accuracy validation
- Accessibility compliance verification
- Link and reference validation
